name: Silken Tofu with Sesame Soy Sauce
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical silken tofu appetizer/side portion size (about 8 oz tofu per serving); recipe serves 2 as a light lunch or 4 as a small side but 2 is conservative for a standalone meal.
Total time is estimate for minimal-prep no-cook recipe: ~5 min draining/slicing + ~5 min garnishing/serving; no explicit times given.
Chinese Sesame Sauce treated as containing sesame (allergen true) and conservatively as possibly containing wheat/soy compounds (ambiguous).
Gluten-free is null due to unspecified soy sauce (often contains wheat) and possible wheat in compound sesame sauce.
Vegan/vegetarian confirmed via all plant-based ingredients with no animal products listed.
Scallions treated as fully edible with no allergens.
instructions:
Prepare the tofu: 
Drain the tofu and gently remove it from its packaging onto a large plate. Carefully slice the tofu into 1/2-inch slabs widthwise. With the palm of your hands, gently push the sliced tofu sidewise so that they fan out over the plate.

Garnish with toppings and serve:
Drizzle the soy sauce and sesame sauce on top. Then garnish it with scallions and sesame seeds, and serve.

Tightly cover leftovers and refrigerate for up to 2 days. You can enjoy it cold straight out of the fridge or you can reheat it by microwaving in 30-second increments until warmed through

ingredients.name: Silken Tofu
ingredients.assumptions: Standard 16 oz (454 g) package of silken tofu; typical values for soft/silken tofu, drained and fully edible.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tbsp regular soy sauce; density ~1 g/ml, typical sodium-reduced not assumed.

ingredients.name: Chinese Sesame Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp Chinese sesame paste/sauce (tahini-like sesame condiment); typical values for pure sesame sauce used in Chinese recipes, not sweetened.

ingredients.name: Scallions
ingredients.assumptions: 1 sliced scallion (green onion); typical weight for one medium scallion including green and white parts, fully edible.

ingredients.name: Sesame Seed
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp sesame seeds; typical weight ~3.5 g per tsp, toasted or raw not specified but values similar.
